_meta.usage: a full landline number in national form (048 123 45 67, (04849) 2-34-56, 0442345678) or the bare zone code (048); drop a leading +380 or +38 first
_meta.note: One zone code per oblast (plus Kyiv, Sevastopol and Crimea). Longer local codes such as 04849 start with the zone code and resolve to the oblast; town-level codes are not in the table (no official list).
_meta.miss_note: not a geographic zone: mobile network codes (050, 063, 066, 067, 068, 073–079, 081–085, 091–099), 0800/0808/0900 service numbers, 086x/089x non-geographic fixed, 087x M2M/IoT, 049x satellite, 039 ported number; or an international prefix left in (+380)
source: https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/laws/show/z1534-23 (National Numbering Plan of Ukraine, order 758 of 26.08.2023, Annex 1; in force)
